why: Classical conjecture remains open (verified computationally to 10^140, proofs only for special forms). 2025 papers by Daniel Martin (divisibility result on Markoff graph mod p components) and David Fisac (combinatorial reformulation via simple length spectrum) touch closely related structures but it is unclear from search snippets alone whether either narrows the classical conjecture itself or only adjacent structure; could not confirm scope without reading the papers.
